author: Iron
body:
Hello,

My alt was banned for its name. However, being on the staff team I am aware that the guidelines state that you may only ban accounts for names that are racist/vulgar/contain very foul language. In the case of my account, it was banned when it does not fall under any of those requirements. Also, the moderator who banned my account informed me that he banned the account because one player decided it was not appropriate. I would like a proper response from resepignev, because he handled the situation terribly. Also note, my account was not banned when I posted on the forums etc. 

Thanks, 
Iron.

title: BerzerkIsSalty-Appeal

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Hello Iron,

your alt was banned because the Teamleader of the team Berzerk was offended by the name BerzerkIsSalty.
You are right with the policy, but in this case it was a special cause since you directly attacked the whole team with your alts name. The Teamleader of Berzerk has the right to demand a name change.
I also want to remind you of the name Iron4Demote. The name was also banned for his name since you were offended. The name doesn't contains any racist, vulgar or very foul language, but still got banned for its name.
I just want to add that I didn't banned you without talking to a Senior Staffmember about the name and the arguments stated by the Teamleader. Another Senior talked with me about the name too, but in the end he agreed with the ban.
In the end your alt can get easily unbanned when you change your name and make an appeal on the forums.

The two kicks for "Enforcing punishment" also got removed on my demanding.

Now I would like to know what you mean with "handling the situation terribly". I consulted a higher staffmember about the name and stated the opinions of the Teamleader without saying what my opinion is on that name.

Regards Flo/resepignev

replies.author: Iron
replies.body: For starters, the rule had not been established yet. Second, one person who is known for hating me stated that he disliked my account, not the team. One person. Did you ask anyone else if they found it offensive?

replies.author: Iron
replies.body: You do realize I just changed my alts name so changing it now is not an option, also do not tell me when to appeal. Please.
replies.body_tagged: You do realize I just changed my alts name so changing it now is not an option, also do not tell me when to appeal. Please.

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
If the rule had not been established yet, why do you use it in your argument? and it's just a guideline not a set rule.

Second the Teamleader has to decide on behalf of his team, he wouldn't be the leader if he couldn't speak for the whole team.
If he hates you then you should find out the cause and solve the problems with the person, I only acted on the behalf of him since he reported your account because of its name.
And yes I talked with other persons about the name, as you can read in my first post I asked a Senior Staffmember about the name and after reviewing the arguments of the leader he/we came to the conslusion that the name is inappropriate because it offended the Team Berzerk.

Then you have to wait for the appeal until you changed the name.
